title: Flood Fill
summary: Fills a connected region of a grid starting from a seed cell (like paint bucket).
usage: Image paint-bucket, connected-region labeling, maze/region analysis.

steps.title: Seed at (0,0)
steps.explanation: Start fill from the top-left '1' region.

steps.title: Fill (0,0)
steps.explanation: Mark (0,0) and move to its '1' neighbours.

steps.title: Fill (0,1) & (1,0)
steps.explanation: Both are part of the same connected region.

input.prompt: Will the bottom-right '1' at (2,2) get filled?

steps.title: Region complete
steps.explanation: (2,2) is disconnected, so it stays. Only the connected region changed.
